AntiPattern.WhyBad: Three parallel factories for one SUT (inherited `AX_ONE_UNIFIED_CONTEXT_PER_FILE`). Each drifts independently; structural changes in `OrderLifecycle` require N edits, not one. Reader-agent must learn three shapes instead of one + a set of overrides.
AntiPattern.Good: Single `createOrderLifecycleContext(overrides)` factory; happy / discount / failure cases pass different overrides through the same factory.
